technique_name: Explain the implications of artificial intelligence on the natural environment.
description: The implications of artificial intelligence on the natural environment can be both positive and negative. On the positive side, AI systems can be used to monitor and analyse environmental data more quickly and accurately than humans, leading to a greater understanding of natural ecosystems. Additionally, AI-driven technologies can optimize energy use and reduce waste while providing an efficient alternative to manual labor.
